caption: The drawing features a single blue glass pitcher positioned centrally on a plain, off-white background. The pitcher is depicted in a realistic style and has an ornate design with intricate, raised scrollwork patterns encircling its body. The lower portion of the pitcher displays vertical ribbing, while the upper part has more elaborate and swirling decorative elements. The handle, also blue, curves outward and upward, attaching from the top edge to the midsection with a rounded end. The pitcher’s spout is broad and gently curved. The entire composition is contained within a lightly drawn rectangular border. The artist’s signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Cream Pitcher
